subject: Request: short sprint extension while procurement verifies PO
messages:
From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@cedartech.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cedartech.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Trial access pause — procurement verifying PO

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about the latency and cost profile on Redwood. We started the internal procurement flow yesterday but finance has flagged a compliance review that will add a few business days to PO approval.

We currently have a pilot running (the team is mid-sprint) and are worried the evaluation window will lapse before the PO clears. Is there any short-term option to keep the environment active for another 5 business days while procurement finishes verification? Even a small allotment of tokens would keep our integration testing meaningful.

I can share the PO status snapshot from procurement (attached) and the procurement contact is CC'd. Appreciate any help — we want to avoid restarting the onboarding.

Best,
Amira Khan
Product Manager, CedarTech
amira.khan@cedartech.com

Attachment: CedarTech_PO_status.pdf
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Amira Khan <amira.khan@cedartech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial access pause — procurement verifying PO

Amira — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO snapshot.

We can do a temporary runway to prevent the pilot from stalling. Proposed options:
- 5 business-day extension with a 5k token credit to preserve the integration tests
- 10 business-day extension but smaller token allotment (2.5k) if you prefer a longer window

If you confirm which option you'd like I’ll get operations and finance looped for quick approval. I’ve CC'd Marissa and Neha to expedite.

Goal: not to change contract economics — this is a short-term preservation grant tied to the PO in flight (deal CT-2026-41).

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial access pause — procurement verifying PO

Looping in Sales Ops and Finance — Marissa here.

I support the 5 business-day extension with a 5k token credit. Conditions:
- Credit tied to deal CT-2026-41 and will be revoked if PO is not submitted within the extension window
- No additional discounts or SLA changes implied

Priyom — can Finance clear the small credit administratively? Neha — please update the HubSpot deal and add a note about the credit and expiry.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial access pause — procurement verifying PO

Marissa / team — Finance OK for a one-off 5k token credit tied to the HubSpot deal ID and PO reference. We just need the procurement contact (or Amira) to acknowledge the timeframe in a reply so we have a simple audit trail.

I’ll stage the credit and set it to auto-expire at EOD on 2026-11-20 PT unless we receive PO confirmation earlier.

Priyom Das
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@cedartech.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cedartech.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial access pause — procurement verifying PO

Thanks everyone — CedarTech confirms the timeline and we accept the 5 business-day runway with the 5k token allotment tied to CT-2026-41. Procurement will push the PO through and I’ll send a confirmation when it’s signed.

We’ll use the time to finish the last integration tests and finalize the internal security checklist. Also happy to schedule a 30-minute tuning session with your solutions engineer while we have the environment active.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Amira Khan
Product Manager, CedarTech
amira.khan@cedartech.com
